mapper.select: SELECT FROM problem_review_attempt WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND client_attempt_id = CAST(#{clientAttemptId} AS UUID)

INSERT INTO problem_review_attempt ( review_card_id, user_id, client_attempt_id, rating, scheduling_before_json, scheduling_after_json, reviewed_at ) VALUES ( #{reviewCardId}, #{userId}, CAST(#{clientAttemptId} AS UUID), #{rating}, #{schedulingBeforeJson, typeHandler=org.congcong.algomentor.agent.persistence.postgres.json.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{schedulingAfterJson, typeHandler=org.congcong.algomentor.agent.persistence.postgres.json.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{reviewedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (user_id, client_attempt_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING
